introductionText:
Hi, I'm Léon, 22 years old and a passionate software developer.
My journey into the world of computer science began with an apprenticeship as a computer scientist, which I completed with a vocational baccalaureate. After my training, I worked as a software developer for two years and was able to gain valuable experience in various projects.
I am passionate about modern technologies, efficient software solutions and innovative developments. My focus is on clean code, scalable applications and a user-friendly design. You can find a selection of my previous work and more about my skills and experience in my portfolio.
I look forward to exchanging ideas with like-minded people and exciting new projects.

educationSectionInformations.description: Hover over the elements to learn more.

In the basic training year, I acquired fundamental skills that are essential for software development. From the front end with HTML/CSS and JavaScript to object-oriented programming with Java and PHP to databases and various project management methods, I was able to acquire a solid foundation.

During my four-year apprenticeship, I spent three years working intensively in the field of mobile application development. My focus was on iOS development with Swift/SwiftUI, Objective-C and Xcode. I also gained experience in Android development with Kotlin and Java.
As a team, we worked according to the Scrum method. I was also able to further develop my skills in automated and manual UI testing. In this context, I also came into contact with CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, which ensured the functionality of the code during both continuous development and releases.

In the two years after my apprenticeship, I had the opportunity to work in four different teams, gaining valuable experience and continuously expanding my skillset.
In the first two teams, I was involved in the development of mobile applications, working with SwiftUI, Xcode, Kotlin, Java and Android Studio. I was involved in the development of a trading app and an e-banking app.
In the other two teams, I focused on the development of web applications with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. I was also involved in the further development of a web application for a feedback tool, particularly in the implementation of feedback campaigns.

privacyPolicyText:
**Effective date:** October 19, 2026

**Contact email:** [54coding26@gmail.com](mailto:54coding26@gmail.com)

## 1. Introduction
Welcome to BoxingBuddy. Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how BoxingBuddy ("the App") handles information when you use our mobile application.

BoxingBuddy provides workout and timer features. We use Google AdMob to display advertisements and the Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) to manage consent related to advertising and privacy.

## 2. Information We Collect
You do not need to create an account or provide personal contact details, such as your name, home address, telephone number, or email address, to use the App's core workout and timer features.

However, information may be processed in connection with the display and measurement of advertisements. The information processed depends on factors such as the configuration of the advertising services, your consent choices, and applicable privacy requirements.

## 3. Information Stored on Your Device
The App may store settings, preferences, and other information locally on your device that is necessary for its features to function.

Information stored locally is not automatically transmitted to our own servers. The processing carried out by third-party services is described in the following sections.

You may be able to remove locally stored information by deleting the App or using the available settings on your device.

## 4. Advertising, Analytics, and Tracking
BoxingBuddy uses Google AdMob, an advertising service provided by Google, to display advertisements within the App.

In connection with the delivery, display, measurement, and improvement of advertisements, the Google Mobile Ads SDK may process information. Depending on the configuration and your consent status, this may include:

- Device identifiers, including advertising identifiers where available and permitted;
- Approximate location information;
- Information about interactions with advertisements and the use of advertising features;
- Advertising data and technical diagnostic and performance information;
- IP addresses and other technical information, where processed by the service.

The information actually processed depends on the SDK configuration, device settings, consent choices, and applicable legal requirements.

Depending on the configuration, Google may use data for personalized or non-personalized advertising, measuring advertising performance, fraud prevention, and other purposes described in Google's privacy information.

## 5. Consent Management with Google UMP
BoxingBuddy uses the Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) to display required privacy and consent messages and manage consent choices.

Depending on your location and applicable requirements, you may be shown a message allowing you to select relevant privacy and advertising options.

Where available, you may be able to change or withdraw your consent or reopen privacy options through the App.

Consent management does not automatically mean that no information is processed. Processing depends on your choices, the technical configuration, and applicable requirements.

## 6. Third-Party Services
We use the following services for advertising and consent management:

**Google AdMob:** A service for delivering and measuring advertisements.

**Google User Messaging Platform (UMP):** A library for managing privacy messages and consent choices.

These services are provided by Google. Google may process information in accordance with its own privacy policies and the settings of the relevant services.

For more information, please see:

- [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)
- [Information about Google advertising](https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads)
- [AdMob information for iOS](https://developers.google.com/admob/ios/privacy)

Your use of iOS and the App Store is also subject to Apple's privacy and security practices.

## 7. Data Sharing and Disclosure
We do not sell personal information.

In connection with the delivery of advertisements, information may be processed by Google as the provider of the integrated advertising services. Such processing depends on the service terms, technical configuration, and your consent choices.

Information may also be disclosed where required by applicable law or a valid legal process.

## 8. Data Retention and Deletion
BoxingBuddy does not require a user account for its core workout and timer features.

Information stored locally by the App remains on your device until it is removed by you, by the App, or through your device's settings.

Information processed by Google in connection with advertising is subject to Google's applicable retention and deletion practices. For further details, please see the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

## 9. Children's Privacy
BoxingBuddy is not intended to knowingly collect personal information from children without the safeguards required by applicable law.

If you believe that personal information has been processed in connection with BoxingBuddy in violation of applicable law, please contact us at [54coding26@gmail.com](mailto:54coding26@gmail.com).

## 10. Security
We aim to minimize privacy risks and limit the information handled by the App to what is necessary for its features.

Third-party services apply their own technical and organizational safeguards to information they process. However, no method of electronic storage or transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

## 11. Your Privacy Rights
Depending on your location, you may have rights relating to your personal information. These may include the right to access, correct, or delete information, restrict processing, and withdraw consent.

If you have questions about information processing by BoxingBuddy, please contact us at [54coding26@gmail.com](mailto:54coding26@gmail.com).

For information processed by Google as a provider of its services, you can also consult the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy) and the privacy options described there.

## 12. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes to the App, the services we use, applicable laws, or our privacy practices.

When we make changes, we will update the effective date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

## 13. Contact Us
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or BoxingBuddy's privacy practices, please contact us:

**Email:** [54coding26@gmail.com](mailto:54coding26@gmail.com)

projects.description:
This project is a simple but practical interval timer that I developed with SwiftUI in Xcode.
The timer is particularly suitable for use in sports, as it makes it possible to control training intervals. Users can set individually defined time intervals for activities and breaks, which makes training more efficient.
The user-friendly interface and ease of use make the timer a useful tool for athletes of all levels.

blueprintInformations.name: Website - Architecture
blueprintInformations.text: To best showcase my diverse skills in software development, I deliberately used a wide range of technologies when building this website – technologies I have learned and applied throughout my career.

blueprintInformations.name: Frontend
blueprintInformations.text: This website is based on ReactJS and was built entirely from scratch using HTML and CSS. I place great importance on a clear and maintainable architecture, achieved through a well-structured file system and meaningful naming of variables, classes, and components.

blueprintInformations.name: Packages
blueprintInformations.text:
To optimize the user experience and simplify certain processes, I use selected packages that support animations and internationalization, among other things.
Used packages:
i18next – for multilingual support
react-confetti – for visual effects
react-simple-typewriter – for animated typing effects
react-vertical-timeline-component – for displaying timelines

blueprintInformations.name: Version Control
blueprintInformations.text:
For version control, I use Git in combination with GitHub. I regularly sync changes with the remote repository on the origin branch.
By using feature branches, I ensure that new features are developed and tested independently, without compromising the stability of the main version.

blueprintInformations.name: Hosting
blueprintInformations.text: The website is hosted via GitHub Pages – a simple and efficient way to publish static websites directly from a Git repository.
